name: DuckDB Full-Text Search (FTS) BM25 Term Relevance Scoring
description: Traditional databases use simple `LIKE '%search%'` which treats 1 mention the same as 10 mentions and ignores document frequency. BM25 scores term saturation and document rarity.
prompt:
Traditional databases use simple `LIKE '%search%'` which treats 1 mention the same as 10 mentions and ignores document frequency. BM25 scores term saturation and document rarity.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: doc_id, title, bm25_score.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- BM25 full-text search for 'analytical database'
            WITH scored_articles AS (
                SELECT 
                    doc_id,
                    title,
                    body,
                    fts_main_articles.match_bm25(doc_id, 'analytical database') AS bm25_score
                FROM articles
            )
            SELECT 
                doc_id,
                title,
                ROUND(bm25_score, 4) AS bm25_score
            FROM scored_articles
            WHERE bm25_score IS NOT NULL
            ORDER BY bm25_score DESC;
why_it_fails: ILIKE matches substrings blindly (e.g. 'cat' matches 'scattered' or 'certificate') with zero relevancy ranking.
